material_deprivation_indicator_geo20.long_description: Based on the Towsend Material Deprivation Index, it examines the private material resources available to households in a community. 4 indicators make up Towsend: overcrowding (>2 persons per room), unemployment, % of persons no vehicle or car, and % of person who rent.
material_deprivation_indicator_geo20.short_description: Based on the Towsend Material Deprivation Index, it examines the private material resources available to households in a community.
material_deprivation_indicator_geo20.provenance: Based on the Townsend Material Deprivation Index (Townsend et al., 1988), which combines four census-derived indicators -- unemployment, overcrowding, non-car ownership, and non-home ownership -- to measure area-level material deprivation. Adapted for U.S. Census variables.
